notes: expect: reply | none | peer. follow adds one more mail inside the same scenario:
reply = the harness replies to the collaborator's reply and expects a second reply,
immediate = a second mail sent in the same tick, while-working = a second mail sent once the collaborator reports working.
needs lists the mail tools the scenario legitimately requires beyond collaborator_inbox/collaborator_reply.
fillerToken in a body is expanded so the whole body is exactly 8192 bytes.
